value.title: Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected, Stored, DOM) Methodology
value.content: {"id": "portswigger_xss", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "xss", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)", "name": "Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected, Stored, DOM) Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-79", "owasp_category": "A03:2021 - Injection", "signals": ["unescaped_input_reflection", "html_attribute_reflection", "script_context_reflection", "dom_sink_flow", "csp_header_missing", "content_type_text_html"], "verification_strategy": "Submit unique alphanumeric canary tokens (e.g. z9x8w7v6) across query parameters and form fields, evaluate reflection contexts (HTML text, HTML attribute, JS string), and verify character encoding for <, >, \", ', and backticks.", "evidence_requirements": ["canary_reflection_context", "raw_response_snippet", "csp_policy_analysis"], "tools": [{"tool": "XSSSkill", "cmd": "run_xss_skill(url, param)", "desc": "Context-aware AST reflection & breakout analyzer"}, {"tool": "dalfox", "cmd": "dalfox url 'https://example.com/search?q=test' --skip-bavl --mining-dict", "desc": "High-performance parameter analysis and DOM XSS scanner"}, {"tool": "BrowserAgent (Firefox)", "cmd": "BrowserAgent.run(target, mode='xss_dom_check')", "desc": "Headless/GUI browser execution auditing DOM sinks (eval, innerHTML)"}], "remediation": "Apply context-sensitive output encoding before rendering user input into HTML, attributes, or JavaScript contexts. Deploy a rigorous Content Security Policy (CSP) with nonce-based or hash-based script execution.", "description": "PortSwigger XSS covers Reflected XSS into HTML contexts, attribute contexts, JavaScript templates, Stored XSS, and DOM-based XSS traversing execution sinks like location.href, innerHTML, document.write, and jQuery selectors."}
